instruction: Cinematic medium close-up of a bright ballet studio. In the foreground, the blonde ballerina (R2) in a white leotard sits with her head tilted down, looking contemplative. In the background, the dark-haired ballerina (R1) in a white leotard stands with arms raised overhead in an expressive ballet pose, softly out of focus. Soft natural light streams from the side, illuminating the scene in clean, bright tones with a shallow depth of field.
elements: R1 stands with arms raised overhead in an expressive ballet pose rather than R2
R2 sits with head tilted down looking contemplative rather than R1
R2 is seated in the foreground while R1 stands in the background
R1 is softly out of focus behind R2
bright ballet studio with soft natural side light
